chunks: Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, who said: Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام said:
In the case of the missing person, his wealth is held back for four years, then it is divided.

key_terms.أَرْبَعُ سِنِينَ: a waiting period of four years
key_terms.الْمَفْقُودِ: a missing person whose condition and whereabouts are unknown
key_terms.يُقْسَمُ: it is divided among the heirs

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the wealth of a missing person in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the estate of a missing person. It states that the missing person’s wealth is to be kept undistributed for four years, after which it is divided according to the law of inheritance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5707 - Yunus ibn Abd Al-Rahman narrated from Ishaq ibn Ammar who said that Abu Al-Hasan (as) said:
"In the case of a missing person (mafqud), his wealth is withheld for four years, and then it is divided."
